result.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feedback_revisions(p_post_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(post_id uuid, revision jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p.id, public.feedback_revision(p.id) from public.posts p where p.id = any(p_post_ids)
$function$
